summary: Frontend retest of the studioGrade.js live-checker fix (opened_count / sent_count / table_cells_filled), email read-state visual, and 'ai'-kind task marker. ALL reported bugs are FIXED: (1) email-task1 'Triage Your Inbox' — each opened inbox row visibly switches to read (cyan email-unread-dot-<id> removed, row gets opacity-60/slate-400); Your Tasks ticked live: t1 green at exactly 8 reads, t2 green on typing in email-search, t3 green at 10 reads; Submit -> A, 'Score 100% · 3/3 tasks', +150 HP, +1 Mark. (2) RECORDED: hub card blocktask-card-email-task1 shows 'Passed ✓ / 100%' and guide /api/studio/reports/all shows email tasks passed 2/3 for em-exp. (3) email-task2: sent_count(min 3) stayed unticked at 1 and 2 sends and ticked at the 3rd (reply/forward/compose), opened_count(min 2) pre-satisfied t6 correctly, submit A 6/6. (4) table_cells_filled ticked live at exactly the 8th cell (docs-d9 t2). (5) email-m10 'ai' tasks t2/t3/t4 render the neutral Wand2 marker (studio-task-tN-ai) + 'AI-graded on submit' label, are excluded from the denominator (counter 0/4 -> 4/4 for 7 total tasks), show NO red X after submit, and AI Coach feedback panel rendered with grade A (+90 HP). (6) Regression: after a real submit, unmet deterministic tasks DO show studio-task-<id>-missing red X. NEW HIGH bug found: docs-d9 Tables Drill task t1 requires a 4-col x 3-row table but the insert-table picker only offers 3x2/2x3/3x3/4x2/2x2 — the drill can never be passed (caps at 50%, grade F).

minor.issue: Response returns sticky best_score with the CURRENT passed/total, so the dialog can read 'Score 50% · 0/2 tasks' (confusing to students). Consider showing last_score alongside, or labelling it 'Best score'.

11 stale-expectation failures (curriculum grew 12 -> 14 email missions and several missions gained t5/t6 tasks; guides now get a 200 grade-preview instead of 403). Not regressions of this fix — but the file no longer has regression value until expectations are refreshed.
Stale: guide submit now intentionally returns 200 with preview:true. 24/25 otherwise pass.
Fails when another docs mission still carries an unresolved_writing flag for the same user (test-data sensitive, already noted in iteration_25). 14/15 pass.

ui_bugs.component: DocEditorCore insert-table menu vs docs-d9 Tables Drill
ui_bugs.issue: Task t1 'Insert a table with 4 columns and 3 rows' is unattainable — the picker only offers studio-table-3x2, 2x3, 3x3, 4x2, 2x2. Drill maxes at 1/2 tasks -> 50% -> grade F, can never be mastered (same class of bug as the one just fixed). Add a 4x3 option (ideally a small size grid) or change the task to 4x2.

Red X markers (studio-task-<id>-missing) are tied to `result` state, so clicking 'Keep editing' (setResult(null)) instantly wipes them and the 'Red items still need work' hint — the student loses the failure feedback exactly when they go to fix it. Track a separate `submitted` flag instead.
Folder badge shows TOTAL messages, not unread — Inbox still reads '12' after 10 emails were read, which contradicts the new read/unread visual and the task counter.
Observed stale value after a submit on docs-d9 (nav showed 740 before the award and 700 after, while DB/user was 740). Reproduced once only; verify refresh() ordering after doSubmit.

issues: Pre-existing React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the line-spacing select (dev instrumentation, already noted in iteration_25).
Score line mixes sticky best score with current task count (e.g. 'Score 50% · 0/2 tasks').

action_items: HIGH: add a 4x3 (4-col x 3-row) option to the Docs insert-table picker so docs-d9 t1 is achievable (or retarget the task to an offered size).
MEDIUM: keep red X task markers visible after the result dialog is closed (separate `submitted` state instead of `result`).
LOW: make the email folder badge an unread count (or drop it) so it matches the new read-state visual.
LOW: refresh AppNav points after submit (verify await refresh() ordering).
Housekeeping: refresh stale expectations in tests/test_skillstudio_email.py (14 missions, extra t5/t6 tasks, guide preview 200) and test_skillstudio.py::test_100_guide_403_on_submit.
critical_code_review_comments: studioGrade.js now mirrors backend _check_one for opened_count/sent_count/table_cells_filled — verified live in the UI for all three kinds. Any future backend check kind must be added here too; consider generating/sharing the kind list or adding a parity unit test so the 'task can never tick' class of bug cannot recur.
StudioMission.jsx couples post-submit failure feedback to the transient `result` dialog state; use a dedicated `hasSubmitted` flag.

success_rate.backend: 89% (65/73 across skillstudio/email/writing-coach; all 8 failures are stale expectations or test-data sensitivity, none caused by this fix)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested fix scenarios passed (6/6); 1 new unrelated HIGH bug found (docs-d9 4x3 table unattainable)

seed_data_creation: No new users created. Extended expires_at on all rows in test_database.user_sessions by 30 days (several QA sessions incl. studio_fresh_tok/qa_ui_guide_tok had expired on 2026-08-11, causing blanket 401s in pytest). em-exp now has passes on email-task1 (A/100%), email-task2 (A/100%), email-m10 (A/100%) and an F record on docs-d9.
test_credentials: Explorer em-exp / em_exp_tok, Guide em-guide / em_guide_tok (cookie session_token or Bearer). All sessions re-extended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro used: playwright add_cookies session_token=em_exp_tok on https://explorer-journey-4.preview.emergentagent.com, then /studio/email/email-task1 -> click [data-testid='email-item-inN'] then [data-testid='email-reading-back'] (must click email-folder-inbox after each send in email-task2, since sending switches to Sent). Live task markers: studio-task-<id>-done / -missing / -ai; counter is passedCount/detTasks (excludes ai). Guide recording check: GET /api/studio/reports/all with em_guide_tok (note: /api/studio/reports?track=... does NOT exist -> 'Track not found'). Remaining open items: docs-d9 4x3 table option, red-X persistence after closing the dialog, stale email pytest expectations.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: studioGrade.js (client mirror of backend skillstudio._check_one) lacked opened_count/sent_count/table_cells_filled, so those tasks always evaluated false -> checklist stuck at 0/N and the mission never looked completable/recordable. Fix verified end-to-end: all three kinds now tick live, submissions grade 100% and are persisted in studio_progress + surfaced on the hub and guide reports. New unrelated blocker with the same symptom: docs-d9 t1 (table cols=4 rows=3) can never be satisfied because the UI cannot create a 4x3 table.
